The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and employs a linear scale from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  

The first line, representing GPT-4o, is blue with circular markers and a solid line style. Starting at a value of 24.4 at an x-value of 1, the line increases to 28.9 at an x-value of 3, and then to 27.8 at an x-value of 5, concluding at 24.4 at an x-value of 7. 

The second line, representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet, is light blue with x-shaped markers and a solid line style.  It begins at a value of 26.7 at an x-value of 1, rises to 34.4 at an x-value of 5, and decreases to 20.0 at an x-value of 7.
